_comment: Data-driven smoke coverage. Each entry pairs a seeded page (/{slug}-test/, created by seed.sh from templates/{slug}.json) with frontend assertions. To add a widget: (1) export an Elementor page containing it to templates/{slug}.json, (2) add an entry here. smoke.spec.ts generates one test per entry. Use a bespoke *.spec.ts (see info-box.spec.ts) only when assertions exceed 'element renders + contains text'.
